statements.statement: The member presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered.
The service was ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes and guide further management.
The diagnoses were I48.91 and I48.0.
The denial reason code was CO-197.
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before the service was rendered.
